title: DAMADICS benchmark, Lublin Sugar Factory real plant data files (2001 campaign)
authors: Michał Bartyś and Michał Syfert (data description)
publisher: Warsaw University of Technology, Institute of Automatic Control and Robotics
version: Four archive parts for 2001-10-29 through 2001-11-22; technical data description v. 02March2002 (15 pages)
rights: Official project supplies the ZIPs freely for benchmark use. No explicit data redistribution licence identified on its data page or in the accompanying data description. Only original aggregate statistics, citation and retrieval details are shared.
evidence_level: Four original archive parts downloaded, 25 complete daily files parsed, official 15-page manual read (table 1, tables 3–5 and accompanying figures).

queries: DAMADICS Sugar Factory valve controller output rod displacement actuator benchmark real data
Crossref query.bibliographic=Introduction to the DAMADICS actuator FDI benchmark study
search_log.screening: Used the official Data files section for measured plant signals and the intervention manual. DABLib and simulation models are distinct benchmark resources.

derived: Each daily archive member has 86,400 seconds × 33 channels. From 25 dates obtain 2,160,000 timestamps per valve, 6,480,000 command/rod pairs over three valves. Daily outputs contain finite-cell counts, command endpoints, absolute command–rod gap and process information. Intervals use inclusive manual labels (18 bounded) and equally long immediately preceding descriptive references. A nineteenth start-only annotation has no invented end or measurements.
observations: A1 f16, 2001-11-09: mean absolute command/rod gap 0.831884 percentage points in 276 preceding samples versus 57.851449 across 276 intervention samples, peak 98.2 and 92 command observations at 100% closing.

A2 f19 manual footnote: plant flow present in the release was fault-free; the signal inside the flow control loop received the intervention. The raw stored flow need not show the sensor perturbation itself.
limits: The collection page mentions Oct 27–Nov 23 but its four actual ZIPs have 25 dates, Oct 29–Nov 22 inclusive.

Percent refers to valve closing. Flow unit is m³/h for actuators 1/2 and t/h for actuator 3. A bounded or discrepant controller output does not by itself diagnose stiction or a specific hardware limit. The field trials explicitly cover f16–f19; the larger f1–f19 taxonomy also contains simulated cases.

Neighboring windows can contain other disturbances and are not a randomized control. Manual Table 3 gives item 3 end 58930 despite apparent figure-caption typo. The recorded command is already the controller output and no unclamped command is supplied.
reproduce: Download the four Lublin_all_data_part{1..4}.zip into INPUT. Run python derive_damadics.py INPUT OUT (NumPy/pandas); see damadics-valve-days.csv and damadics-fault-windows.csv.
